title: the-monolith - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: the-monolith in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The tower at the north of the Continent and the setting for the end of Act 2. It contains the Paint Cage system, Renoir's fight and The Paintress.

sections.title: How to Reach the-monolith
sections.content: Reached at the end of the Act 2 route. The Paint Cage mechanic requires Paint Spikes collected across the world.

sections.title: Bosses Here
sections.content: Renoir, The Paintress, Gargant, Clair Obscur, Mime, Veilleur, Noire, Obscur

sections.title: Collectibles & Notable Loot
sections.content: Lithelim, Braselim, Garganon, Veremum, Dreameso, Simoso route
